_comment: Spoken lines for English (docs/design/voices.md). Other languages get their own file (content/voice/<lang>.json) with the same keys, and content packs add or replace lines under the same keys with a top-level "voice": {"en": {...}} (docs/content-packs.md). Keys are content ids. social: per social interaction, start (said by the one who starts it), good and bad (the answer, by outcome). object: per object id, lines for any of its interactions and, under interactions, per interaction id. interaction: per interaction id, on any object. action: per animation tag. emotion: per emotion id. thought: per planner thought kind. For something being used, the most specific lines win: object + interaction, then object, then interaction id, then animation tag. A group is a list of lines, or {"lines": [...], "tone": ...}; tones: happy, sad, angry, flirty, question. {name} is the other resident's first name, {me} the speaker's. A line may fix a pronunciation with [word](/phonemes/) (Misaki's alphabet). Keep lines short (most under 40 characters) and right for children, teens and grown-ups alike (babies don't speak); several per key, as a resident doesn't repeat their last few. cargo test -p voice --release --test lines checks every line.
